title: Signal: Shell command executed through std::system in cpp — review required
scope: Single-line match on std::system in cpp.
limitations: Lexical: matches std::system and ::system calls; a spawn-based wrapper is out of scope.

examples.line: # verified: posix_spawn(&pid, "/usr/bin/convert", nullptr, nullptr, argv, environ);
